digest.component_or_area: CI workflows and Git fetch optimization
propositions: CI ticket fetches must apply --filter=blob:none to reduce transfer size from >1 GB to <100 MiB across checkout and Gerrit verify-identity workflows
Named-remote fetch inheritance and direct-URL fetch operations must negotiate filter capability with git daemon and exclude historical blobs while retaining complete commit graph for merge-base
Production guards must parse git count-objects -v and reject fetches exceeding REBAR_CHECKOUT_PACK_LIMIT_KIB=102400 or REBAR_TICKETS_PACK_LIMIT_KIB=131072 thresholds
Blobless materialization must not add promisor objects during identity verification and must support independent local/remote changes with ours-driver merge and push
Git protocol must advertise filter capability and send filter blob:none in packet trace for named-origin, depth-1 direct URL, and full-history direct URL fetch paths
